title: Hush
kicker: A real village under corporate designation, protected by ward pillars.
hook: A real village under corporate designation, protected by ward pillars.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Hush is warm before it is safe: low roofs, clover smoke, hand-repaired doors, and ward posts humming just a little off-key.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Moss softens every lane until your footsteps go quiet, so you hear the canals first, then laundry snapping on a line, then a hundred small repairs underway at once. Doors hang a little crooked and patched with obvious care. On the ward posts at the water...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place Ratcoons work the canals and porch edges Festival Moths drift near moss lanterns Young Dryads watch hospitality from the tree line small fish flash under planks No default combatant; add only if the scene...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: The kettle is already on when you arrive, because it always is. Moss-honey ends up in everything, the tea, the bread, the bottom of a thank-you. Canal fish come up small and silver and get fried whole. A neighbor hands...
